text:
Ana Gomez: FYI — billing policy update rolling next month: were introducing minute-smoothing for microbursts and a tiny cross-route reserve allocation for free credits. This is an allocation/UX change, not a rate increase. :loudspeaker:

Ana Gomez: Summary:
- Minute-smoothing: microbursts within a 5-10 minute rolling window will be smoothed to reduce noisy overage events.
- Cross-route reserve: accounts receive a 1% automatic reserve of monthly free credits to cover tiny cross-route spikes.
- Per-route visibility: Console will show per-route credit breakdowns and a new invoice annotation when smoothing applied.

Noah Reed: quick validation notes: tested on 1.5k mid-size customers. Peak counts reduced ~23% with negligible impact on revenue. Implementation lives in the metering service behind flag billing.minute_smoothing.v2.

Priya Malhotra: Support FAQ (short):
- "Will I lose credits?" -> No, credits are redistributed and a small reserve is added.
- "Will I be billed more often?" -> Likely fewer surprise overage lines due to smoothing.

Ana Gomez: Rollout plan:
- Week 0: feature flag + preview UI showing projected per-route balances.
- Week 1: dry-run for a sample cohort, no invoice changes.
- Week 2: global migration; invoices will include line item "smoothing_applied" for affected cycles.

Noah Reed: API preview: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/credits/preview?feature=minute_smoothing"

Priya Malhotra: Action items:
- @noah: enable preview endpoint and console card (ETA 48h)
- @pri: KB + canned responses (ETA 24h)
- @finance: expect new invoice annotation and confirm tax/legal impact (ETA 48h)

finance-bot: Automated: feature_flag billing.minute_smoothing.v2 created, owner @noah, audit_id=fb-2451000001.

Ana Gomez: Dedicated/Private customers: default behavior unchanged unless they opt in. Well provide an opt-out for hosted accounts for first 30 days post-migration.

Noah Reed: Telemetry request: billing.smoothing.peak_reduction_pct and billing.reserve.utilization. Eng-infra please add.

Priya Malhotra: Customer comms: we will email active customers 72h before full migration and show a console banner. Draft coming to #announcements tomorrow.

Ana Gomez: Thanks all. If anyone sees major issues in the dry run, flag here or DM me. Thread closed for now.
